test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

The __man supervising the exam__ had a huge moustache.
solution:
The correct answer is **Invigilator**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Invigilator:** A person who supervises students during an examination. (निरीक्षक)

 
 
• **Example**: No food or drink is allowed into an examination without permission from the ***invigilator***.
 
 
 
• Thus, the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• **Invigilator **is the person who keeps vigil, watch, supervises students at an examination. His main job is to see that examinees do not resort to any unfair means and the examination is conducted smoothly.
 
• **Examiner **is a person who sets and marks exams to test examinees' knowledge or proficiency.
 
• The given underlined phrase talks about supervising the exam. Thus, the correct answer is Invigilator.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Examiner: **a person who tests somebody in an exam. (परीक्षक)
 
• **Curator: **a person whose job is to look after the things that are kept in a museum. (संग्रहालय का अध्यक्ष)
 
• **Controller: **a person in a business organization or government who is responsible for managing its finances. (नियंत्रक, नियंत्रणकर्ता)
